concerns.text: FR-009 requires a control experiment masking API/doc tokens to verify correlations are not artifacts. The plan.md 'Methodology' section lists the three descriptors and retrieval pipelines but contains no mention of a 'masking' experiment, 'control experiment', or token masking logic. This FR is unbacked in the plan.

FR-010 requires a manual spot-check validation of ground truth labels to estimate noise. The plan.md 'Methodology' and 'Dataset Strategy' sections describe automated loading and processing but do not include a task, script, or phase for manual spot-checking or noise estimation. This FR is unbacked in the plan.

SC-006 requires measuring label noise against a manual spot-check sample. Since the plan lacks a corresponding task for the manual spot-check (see FR-010 concern), there is no mechanism to measure this success criterion. The plan is silent on this SC.
